description: Sets the business's goal: the one outcome the plan works toward, counted by Marsell (GitHub stars, sign-ups, bookings, money raised, sales). words: the owner's own words, read by a small model (a few tokens) into what it counts, the target and the day; when they name no amount or could mean two goals, nothing is set and the answer says what was understood, so ask the owner again. use_suggestion: the owner takes Marsell's suggestion as it is. situation_read goal shows the goal now. It needs an act key.

owner_words.description: The owner's own words, exactly as they said them: what an argument ending in _from_message keeps.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

use_suggestion.description: true when the owner takes Marsell's suggested goal as it is

words.description: the owner's goal in their own words, exactly as they said it: '500 stars by Christmas', '20 tours a week this summer', '$5k a month'

words_from_message.description: true when the owner's goal is the message they just sent: it is read exactly as sent, so you never retype it

name: set_goal
title: Set goal
